UPDATE repository_import_jobs SET status='RUNNING',current_step='validating',started_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=(SELECT id FROM repository_import_jobs WHERE status='QUEUED' ORDER BY created_at FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1) RETURNING *
mapper.update: UPDATE repository_import_jobs SET current_step=#{step},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND status='RUNNING'
UPDATE repository_import_jobs SET cancel_requested=TRUE,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND (#{admin}=TRUE OR account_id=#{actorId}) AND status IN('QUEUED','RUNNING')
